name: Vani Sabesan
headline: Orthopaedic shoulder and elbow surgeon

affiliation.name: Orthopedic Center of Palm Beach County

on_the_show: Dr. Sabesan talked frankly about the limits of surgery. She puts rotator cuff problems at roughly 17 million people and about one in three people over 60, and said surgeons are good at repairing cuffs but not yet good at getting them to heal. She described a head to head study in which patients who started moving within a week did as well as those kept in a sling for six weeks, and a survey in which 98 percent of shoulder replacement patients said their therapist had a big impact on the outcome. Mike noted she is the first woman chosen to lead the Florida Orthopaedic Society.
on_the_show_quote: We’re really good at fixing them. We’re not great at getting them to heal.

background.text: She is a board certified orthopaedic surgeon and shoulder and elbow specialist with the Orthopedic Center of Palm Beach County.
She earned her undergraduate degree at Duke University and her medical degree at Indiana University School of Medicine, then completed her orthopaedic surgery residency at Duke University.
She completed fellowship training in shoulder and elbow surgery and sports medicine at the Cleveland Clinic, along with a Doris Duke Clinical Research Fellowship at the University of Iowa.

She previously served as Chief of Quality and held the Lang Family Endowed Chair in Orthopaedic Research at Cleveland Clinic Florida, and was program director of the orthopaedic residency at HCA Florida JFK/University of Miami.
She has published more than 105 peer reviewed articles and has served on the Florida Orthopaedic Society Board and as its program chair.
Outside the operating room she has run more than 25 marathons and completed an Ironman.

research_notes: Identity confirmed: shoulder and elbow orthopaedic surgeon in Palm Beach County, Duke trained, marathon runner (28 on air, 25+ on her practice page, consistent). FOS presidency: the floridaorthopaedicsociety.org leadership and past-presidents pages returned 403 to every fetch, so I could not open them; a search snippet indicated the FOS leadership page lists her as 2026-2027 President. Kept the presidency only in on_the_show (attributed to what was said on air), not in background. Her practice page says board certified but does not name the board. She has several offices (Atlantis, Boynton Beach, Wellington, Boca Raton, Jupiter); location set to Atlantis, the first listed. An older HCA Florida bio gives Beaumont/Wayne State as her earlier residency directorship while the OCPBC page names HCA Florida JFK/University of Miami; both may be true at different times, I used only the current OCPBC wording. Social links were not opened individually (Instagram/Facebook/X block the sandbox); they rest on being linked from her official pages.
